versions.content: When a server runnable is configured to receive requests from multiple callers located on another ECU, in which the signals from all callers fan-in to a single SystemSignal and the related response signals fan-out from a single Sys- temSignal , the RTE shall ensure that for any incoming call the server return values are sent over the response ISignal based on the configuration of ISignalTrig- gering s and PhysicalChannel s.
